# StatCard
Atlas Stat card v1 — one headline metric on an outlined Card: the label, the period it covers, a large value and an optional delta against the previous period. 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), a loading state and 3 sentiments for the delta.

USE WHEN
· A dashboard or summary shows a single number the user should read at a glance (visitors, revenue, conversion rate).
· Several metrics sit in a row or grid and share the same filters.
· The metric has a period, and optionally a comparison with the previous one.
DON'T USE WHEN
· A trend or many values over time are the point → Chart.
· Exact rows of data → Table.
· The card must be clicked to drill down → not supported in v1; compose a Card with interactive.
· One record's fields are shown → Card.
HOW TO USE
· Set the label as the metric name and the period on every card (Last 7 days); a metric with no period is ambiguous.
· Give delta a trend (up, down or flat) and its comparison text; the word up, down or flat is part of the text so the meaning never relies on colour.
· Sentiment follows the trend by default (up good, down bad). Override it when down is good, such as error rate or latency.
· While data loads set loading; the value and the delta show skeletons in the final shape.
· No data is content, not a state: show an em dash as the value and leave the delta out.
· Use sm in dense grids, md by default, lg for hero metrics. Keep the same size in a row.
· In Figma the label, period, value and delta text are edited in the nested Card; hide the Delta layer to omit it.
· Set Leading icon to on for a 16 px icon above the value, then swap the icon on the instance. The icon is decorative and stays while the card is loading.
DO
· Keep at most four cards in the first view.
· Stack one card per row on a phone.
DON'T
· Show a number with no period or comparison.
· Show an up or down change by colour alone.
RELATED
· Card — the surface Stat card is built on.
· Badge — carries the delta.
· Skeleton — the loading shape.
· Chart — for a series over time.

PROPERTIES
Size: sm | md | lg. State: default | loading. Sentiment: positive | negative | neutral (the delta Badge: success, danger, neutral). Leading icon: off | on.
